semantics: Typed client errors preserve the distinction between missing, conflict, invalid input, unavailable member, cancellation, timeout, and protocol failure.
Cancellation stops work at the documented seam and does not turn an unknown write outcome into a retry without an idempotency decision.
Each retryable operation declares whether replay is safe; non-idempotent document writes require an acknowledgement or caller-visible unknown outcome.
